mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.rental_date, r.return_date, r.total_price, r.status, u.user_id, u.user_name, m.model_name, m.model_brand, p.parking_name FROM reservations r JOIN user u ON r.user_num = u.user_num JOIN car c ON r.car_id = c.car_id JOIN model m ON c.model_id = m.model_id JOIN parking p ON c.rental_station = p.parking_id ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.*, u.user_id, u.user_name, m.model_name FROM reservations r JOIN user u ON r.user_num = u.user_num JOIN car c ON r.car_id = c.car_id JOIN model m ON c.model_id = m.model_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
